Yuki N.: Heads-up: AzureWorks (acct 6701) monthly invoice for May shows full list price — their committed-use discount lines are missing. Invoice is ~$15,200 higher than portal. Can someone look?

billing-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-10-11T12:03:01Z finished with 1 WARN. WARN: 1 invoice(s) generated with missing discount metadata. job id job_20261011_1203

Sam P.: Invoice id?

Yuki N.: INV-2026-05-06701 (pdf: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-05-06701.pdf; raw: s3://billing-outputs/2026/05/INV-2026-05-06701.json)

Avery (Acct): Also noticed two invoice drafts in the UI: INV-2026-05-06701 and INV-2026-05-06701-dup. Both Draft. Autopay off. Please hold captures.

Sam P.: Pulling raw... quick glance: discount_lookup service returned 500 for several customer tiers during generation and generator treated that as "no discount". There's also a duplicated db insert path that created the -dup id when retry happened.

Sam P.: Snippet: generator calls discount-lookup and if response.status !== 200 it proceeds without discount. We should fail-fast or mark invoice "requires-discount".

Yuki N.: Holds applied on both by me. billing-bot please log.

billing-bot: action logged: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-05-06701 by Yuki N. at 2026-10-11T12:12:08Z

Sam P.: Quick remedial plan: (1) make generator treat non-200 as transient and set requires-discount flag, (2) add idempotent create to avoid dup ids on retries, (3) re-run generation for acct 6701 only after fix. I'll open a hotfix.

Sam P.: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/invoice-gen/pulls/318 — adds retry on discount-lookup and idempotent invoice create. Requesting hotfix deploy.

finance-ops-bot: provisional_credit created PC-2026-10-0015 $15,200.00 linked to INV-2026-05-06701 and INV-2026-05-06701-dup by Avery (Acct) at 2026-10-11T12:18:41Z

Sam P.: Deploy done to staging, tests green. Scheduling prod deploy in 10m.

Yuki N.: After prod deploy, please run: billing-reprocess --account 6701 --period 2026-05 --mode regenerate --reason "missing committed-use discount"

billing-bot: job_reproc_6701_202605 started at 2026-10-11T13:05:03Z

billing-bot: job_reproc_6701_202605 completed at 2026-10-11T13:27:19Z. Result: regenerated invoice INV-2026-05-06701-corrected.pdf uploaded s3://billing-outputs/2026/05/INV-2026-05-06701-corrected.pdf. Duplicate INV-2026-05-06701-dup voided.

Avery (Acct): Verified corrected invoice includes committed-use discounts and totals now match portal. Converted provisional credit PC-2026-10-0015 to official credit memo CM-2026-10-0029 and applied. Notified AzureWorks CS and offered to reimburse any processor fees.

Yuki N.: Filing FIN-5408 with root cause: discount-lookup transient 500 -> missing discount; actions: add requires-discount tag, retry+backoff on lookup, idempotent invoice create, and add monitor for invoice vs portal delta > $1k. Closing issue. :thumbsup:
